idea: Remove the .item() CPU sync from the decode loop
strategy: gpu: remove the .item() CPU sync from the decode loop; keep the next token on device
rationale: argmax(...).item() forces the CPU to wait for the GPU every token, serializing the whole loop.

edits.search:
nxt = int(logits[:, -1, :].argmax(dim=-1).item())     # CPU sync every token
        nxt_t = torch.tensor([[nxt]], device=prompt.device)

reasoning: argmax with keepdim gives the (1,1) next-token tensor directly on device. Values are identical; only the host round-trip is gone.
